svg.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: P2 yield per curve with A/A band and planted control
svg.title: P2 yield per curve with A/A band and planted control
svg.text: P2 prime analogues: yield per curve relative to the class mean, with the A/A band and the planted-control effect
Each point is one curve of the class (sorted by value): pooled relation yield per attempt divided by the class grand mean. Counted metric: exact.
A/A band: grand mean x exp(+-q95 |log ratio|) of the round-parity halves of the same curve (half-data scale, so conservative for full-data points)
planted +20% control: median observed pc/main yield ratio when one curve's cells are replaced by the planted arm
curve farthest from the class mean in this cell. Grey hatched panel: pending (not finished yet). Deferred 36- and 40-bit cells: not run (see table).
no values yet: not a null, not zero
no values yet: not a null, not zero

x axis: curves of the class sorted by yield (one point per curve). y axis: yield / class grand mean, shared across panels. Rows: m = 2 (top), m = 3 (bottom). Columns: class A (h = 128) and class B (h = 300)

at 24, 28 and 32 bits. Source data: p2_yield_per_curve.data.tsv; per-cell statistics from runs/<cell>/analysis.json (frozen p2tool analyze). Positive-control detection: fraction of 200 plantings flagged at
